releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.3 (Crisp Computer Print & Perfect Font Matching)
changelog:
⚡ Razor-Sharp Computer Print Perfection & Flawless Line Typography:
• Line-Level Font Consensus: Preserves authentic font family across line neighbors (e.g. 'For Archana' -> 'Kumar' renders Bold Sans-Serif, never Times New Roman).
• 100% Bold Weight Consensus: Line boldness automatically detects bold headings and signature lines.
• Zero Optical Blur on Prints: Digital documents & clean paper default to 0.0px blur for razor-sharp vector text.
• Solid Pitch Black Ink: Sampler preserves authentic pure #000000 ink on computer prints without charcoal fading.
• Exact CapHeight & Median Baseline: Normalized letter height matches neighboring words down to the pixel.
• Update Loop Permanently Fixed: 24h snooze and strict semantic version checks eliminate repeated update popups.
